_comment: SCHEMA TEMPLATE — this file is NOT read by provenance_check.sh.
Why the sha256 placeholders are 'unpinned:...' on purpose: the gate treats an
unpinned: prefix as an HONEST deferral and prints it verbatim as
'honest-unpinned (<reason>)'. So if this template is ever copied verbatim into
external-inputs.json, the gate CANNOT report a hash as verified — it reports
why it did not verify. That is deliberate: a template that could be mistaken
for real verified data is worse than no template.
To make the gate actually verify: place the fetched artifact at
provenance/cache/<name with / replaced by _> and put its real sha256 here.
